nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; privileged role guarded by onlyOwner.
Pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
mapping(address=>uint) token balances mutated by transfer/transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping of allowances written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
_totalSupply set once in the constructor and reported by totalSupply().
Public token symbol set to POSS in the constructor.
Public token name set to Posscoin in the constructor.
Public decimals value set to 18 in the constructor.
SafeMath.safeAdd: c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a); c = a - b underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul: c = a * b with division back-check.
SafeMath.safeDiv: require(b > 0); c = a / b.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Requires msg.sender == newOwner, then promotes newOwner to owner.
ERC20 transfer moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve writing an arbitrary allowance for spender.
ERC20 transferFrom debiting 'from', decrementing allowance and crediting 'to'.
Sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval (external call) before returning.
onlyOwner rescue that performs an external ERC20 transfer call to an arbitrary tokenAddress.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, rejecting plain ETH.
Constant getter returning balances[tokenOwner].
Constant getter returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Constant getter returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with unchecked subtraction.
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender at deployment.
PossContract constructor minting the whole supply to a hardcoded MEW address.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization and balance keying.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-controlled address in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) inside transferAnyERC20Token.
Integer addition/subtraction in SafeMath relying on require-based overflow/underflow checks.
revert() executed in the fallback function to refuse ether.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, granting the caller privileged control of the contract.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership branches on msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender] using the caller identity.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance of the caller.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the spender.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by onlyOwner through msg.sender comparison.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for its authorization check.
transferOwnership stores the _newOwner argument into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer rewrites balances via safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic; correctness depends on the SafeMath guards.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom mutates balances with safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] with safeSub, consuming the allowance.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry for the spender without a race-condition check.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall reaches an external call to an attacker-supplied spender contract.
The receiveApproval external call re-enters the token contract before approveAndCall returns.
transferAnyERC20Token reaches an external call on an arbitrary token contract address.
safeAdd performs a + b, guarded only by require(c >= a) against overflow.
safeSub performs a - b, guarded only by require(b <= a) against underflow.
The payable fallback executes revert() to reject incoming ether.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] with an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried owner.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping for owner and spender.
PossContract constructor assigns the fixed total supply to _totalSupply.
PossContract constructor credits the entire supply to a hardcoded MEW address.
_newOwner parameter flows into the newOwner state variable through transferOwnership.
safeAdd operand a feeds the addition.
safeAdd operand b feeds the addition.
safeAdd result local c carries the a + b arithmetic result.
safeSub operand a feeds the subtraction.
safeSub operand b feeds the subtraction and the b <= a guard.
safeSub result local c carries the a - b arithmetic result.
transfer recipient parameter 'to' is used as the balances mapping key that is credited.
transfer amount parameter 'tokens' flows into the safeSub/safeAdd balance debits and credits.
approve spender parameter is used as the allowance mapping key.
approve tokens parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom 'from' parameter keys the debited balance and allowance entries.
transferFrom 'to' parameter keys the credited balance entry.
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd balance and allowance arithmetic.
approveAndCall spender parameter becomes the target of the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall tokens parameter is written into the allowance and forwarded to the spender.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external contract.
transferAnyERC20Token tokenAddress parameter becomes the target of an external ERC20 transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token tokens parameter is forwarded to the external token transfer.
balanceOf tokenOwner parameter keys the balances mapping read.
allowance tokenOwner parameter keys the outer allowed mapping read.
allowance spender parameter keys the inner allowed mapping read.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is only a carrier for the transferOwnership write into newOwner, so it folds into function fn_transferOwnership.
safeAdd operand a is a pure numeric argument and folds into function fn_safeAdd.
safeAdd operand b is a pure numeric argument and folds into function fn_safeAdd.
safeAdd result local c is the arithmetic value produced by the guarded addition, so it folds into unsafe operation uo_arithmetic_safemath.
safeSub operand a is a pure numeric argument and folds into function fn_safeSub.
safeSub operand b drives the b <= a guard and folds into function fn_safeSub.
safeSub result local c is the arithmetic value produced by the guarded subtraction, so it folds into unsafe operation uo_arithmetic_safemath.
transfer recipient parameter only selects the credited balance slot and folds into function fn_transfer.
transfer amount parameter is consumed by the balance arithmetic inside fn_transfer.
approve spender parameter is only an allowance key and folds into function fn_approve.
approve tokens parameter is only the stored allowance value and folds into function fn_approve.
transferFrom 'from' parameter is only a mapping key and folds into function fn_transferFrom.
transferFrom 'to' parameter is only a mapping key and folds into function fn_transferFrom.
transferFrom 'tokens' parameter is consumed by the balance and allowance arithmetic inside fn_transferFrom.
approveAndCall spender parameter is the direct target of the external call, so it folds into unsafe operation uo_call_receiveApproval.
approveAndCall tokens parameter is only the stored allowance value and folds into function fn_approveAndCall.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded into the external call payload, so it folds into unsafe operation uo_call_receiveApproval.
tokenAddress parameter is the direct target of the external ERC20 transfer call, so it folds into unsafe operation uo_call_erc20_transfer.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call, so it folds into unsafe operation uo_call_erc20_transfer.
balanceOf tokenOwner parameter is only a mapping key and folds into function fn_balanceOf.
allowance tokenOwner parameter is only a mapping key and folds into function fn_allowance.
allowance spender parameter is only a mapping key and folds into function fn_allowance.
